*# Portable Portrait: Alan Kay (1990)*

- #tags: #alan_kay #youtube #balance #harmony #stress #individual #society
- <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1z37SMYM3H8>
- this is quite a interesting video in which alan kay shows his "pocket he uses to travel,
- I used to be a professional guitarist, AK: "for me the experience of playing music ... feeling like a conduit"
- using a transparent bag to avoid the messiness of the office
- What do you need for Balance (at the end)
- ALL the stuff on the table (he calls it stress reduction stuff) to make him feel he as a balanced day even when he doesn't , in fact he uses the word stress

text:
Hi everyone again! :wave: I published an introductory article on using natural transformations, functors and categories in Я - extremely composable embeddable programming language.
This order in the title is not accidental - functors start making sence in context of natural transformations and categories are rarely interesting without reasoning in terms of mappings between them i.e. functors.
In this article I briefly introduce these concepts and demonstrate how to use other categories in Я besides Arrow (regular functions) - Scope category and Event precategory; along how they are related to each other:
<https://muratkasimov.art/Ya/Articles/Transformations,-functors,-categories/>

text: I do like this atproto stuff. I did local-first coz I did not like the whole cloud thing, I am aligned with Martin Kleppmann that its a trap. But it also sucks because there is no sharing with files on disk, or its kinda of hard anyway. But atproto is like leapfrogging that whole problematic area with movable signed storage, so you kinda of get the networking without the controlling forces of domain registries.
